sentences.text: Generated by NNC Pipeline (nnc adapt) from the port declarations of picorv32_pcpi_div and from its netlist (which inputs clock or reset flops).

This document gives only the ports of the design under verification picorv32_pcpi_div and which part of which port of picorv32_pcpi_div each one carries.
The behaviour of picorv32_pcpi_div is specified only by c_pcpi_div_Design_Specification.md; nothing here adds to it.
